title: codemother's sealed verb names the boats a seal makes ready and moves none
intention: CodeMother's sealed verb hears a green seal and answers with the PROVEME boats it makes ready and those still waiting on a hollow reading; it never queues a boat at clearance or crosses one, because moving a ticket is the ticket's own act (outline 9.6).
why: Measured 2026-11-11: on every green seal the handler queued each PROVEME boat at the clearance gate with codemother's own hand. Real charters admit only Akien and CC, so ~/.cairn/logs/bus.log holds 327 refusals; across codemother's sealed_heard records crossed>0 appears 28 times, the last on 2026-10-14, against 503 with refusals. Outline 9.6 says moving a ticket across its workflow is the ticket's own act and CodeMother's gates only answer it; CC crosses PROVED through cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py cross after the verdict.
traces_to: Outline 9.6 and 3.3.4; Law 6 (the owner alone gates writes); Law 7. Supersedes 1accdc1781aa (a green seal crosses the boat it proves) and b984567d8c05 (a seal waits for its hollow reading).
how: shim.py _handle_sealed: keep the proof check, the red-seal answer, _boats_named_on and the awaiting_hollow split; a boat with a standing hollow reading goes into ready (its ticket id) instead of clearance.queueme. The answer is {accepted, verb, device, proof, verdict, ready, awaiting_hollow}; crossed and refused leave it. The docstring says report-only and why. test_codemother.py: the sealed teeth assert ready and that the fixture history stays empty; the two-ended and hollow-file teeth collapse into the ready tooth; PROVES keys of 1accdc1781aa and b984567d8c05 leave, and a19e05ff6647 maps its four clauses. At BUILDME both superseded tickets' state moves PROVED -> [SUPERSEDED] with superseded_by a19e05ff6647, through the artifact door.

decisions.text: D1: the answer drops crossed and refused rather than returning them empty, so a reader that still looks for a crossing finds nothing rather than a false zero; the tester shim's deliver prints those keys only when present, so it needs no edit. The handler no longer calls declared_machines()['clearance']; the 8754ae677af6 teeth call the gate directly and are untouched.
